tasks.subject: Task 1: Database Migration — meal_logs, generalized food_screenshots, daily_logs.water_l
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the `meal_logs` table, generalize `food_screenshots` to support attaching to either a daily log or a meal log, and add `daily_logs.water_l` — applied to the live Supabase project and reflected in the hand-maintained TypeScript types.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/0002_meal_logs.sql`
- Modify: `types/database.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `meal_logs` table exists with RLS enabled, policy `own_meal_logs`, and an `updated_at` trigger reusing `update_updated_at()`
- [ ] `food_screenshots.daily_log_id` is nullable, `meal_log_id` exists (nullable, FK to `meal_logs.id` on delete cascade), and a check constraint `food_screenshot_exactly_one_target` enforces exactly one of the two is set
- [ ] `daily_logs.water_l` exists as `numeric(3,1)`
- [ ] `types/database.ts` Row/Insert/Update shapes for `meal_logs`, `food_screenshots`, and `daily_logs` match the new schema exactly

**Verify:** `npm run build` → compiles with no TypeScript errors

**Steps:** Write `0002_meal_logs.sql` (create meal_logs + RLS + trigger; alter food_screenshots to drop NOT NULL on daily_log_id, add nullable meal_log_id FK, add exactly-one-target check constraint; alter daily_logs add water_l numeric(3,1)) → apply manually via Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor (no linked CLI project) → hand-update types/database.ts (add water_l to daily_logs Row/Insert/Update, generalize food_screenshots daily_log_id/meal_log_id, add full meal_logs Row/Insert/Update block) → npm run build → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/migrations/0002_meal_logs.sql", "types/database.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["meal_logs table exists with own_meal_logs RLS policy and updated_at trigger", "food_screenshots.daily_log_id nullable, meal_log_id added with exactly-one-target check constraint", "daily_logs.water_l numeric(3,1) added", "types/database.ts matches new schema for meal_logs, food_screenshots, daily_logs"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: meal-logs Query Module — CRUD Hooks, Macro Summing, Shared Nutrition Helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the data-fetching layer for per-meal nutrition: CRUD hooks over `meal_logs`, a pure `sumMealMacros` helper (TDD'd), and the `useNutritionForDate` hook that's the single source of truth for "this date's nutrition totals" — to be consumed by `LogForm`, `MealList`, and `DashboardMetrics` in later tasks.

**Files:**
- Create: `lib/queries/meal-logs.ts`
- Test: `lib/queries/meal-logs.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `sumMealMacros(meals)` sums `calories`/`protein_g`/`fat_g`/`carbs_g` across an array of macro-bearing objects, treating `null` as `0`, always returning numbers
- [ ] `useMealLogsForDate(date)` queries `meal_logs` filtered by `date`, ordered by `created_at` ascending, query key `['meal-logs', date]`
- [ ] `useUpsertMealLog()` inserts or updates a `meal_logs` row (upsert on `id`), and on success invalidates `['meal-logs', date]` and `['daily-log', date]`
- [ ] `useDeleteMealLog()` deletes a `meal_logs` row by id, and on success invalidates the same query keys
- [ ] `useNutritionForDate(date)` returns `{ source: 'meals', calories, protein_g, fat_g, carbs_g, meals }` (summed) when meal rows exist, else `{ source: 'daily', ...daily_logs values, meals: [] }`

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/queries/meal-logs.test.ts` → all tests pass; `npm run build` → compiles

**Steps:** TDD — write failing sumMealMacros tests (sums multiple meals, treats null as zero, empty list returns zeros) → run, verify fail → implement sumMealMacros + useMealLogsForDate + useUpsertMealLog + useDeleteMealLog + useNutritionForDate (combining useDailyLog and useMealLogsForDate) → run, verify pass → npm run build → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/queries/meal-logs.ts", "lib/queries/meal-logs.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/queries/meal-logs.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["sumMealMacros sums macros treating null as zero", "useMealLogsForDate queries meal_logs by date with key ['meal-logs', date]", "useUpsertMealLog upserts on id and invalidates meal-logs/daily-log queries", "useDeleteMealLog deletes by id and invalidates same queries", "useNutritionForDate returns meals-sourced totals when meals exist else daily_logs-sourced totals"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Generalize ScreenshotUploader via UploadTarget
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace `ScreenshotUploader`'s hardcoded `dailyLogId`/`date` props with a discriminated `UploadTarget` union so the same upload-and-AI-extract pipeline serves both daily and per-meal screenshots without duplicating the upload logic.

**Files:**
- Modify: `components/log/screenshot-uploader.tsx`
- Modify: `components/log/log-form.tsx:137-153` (update the call site)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ScreenshotUploader` exports `UploadTarget = { type: 'daily'; dailyLogId: string | null; date: string } | { type: 'meal'; mealLogId: string }` and accepts `target: UploadTarget`
- [ ] For `type: 'daily'`, behavior is unchanged: lazily upserts a `daily_logs` row when `dailyLogId` is null, then inserts `food_screenshots` with `daily_log_id`
- [ ] For `type: 'meal'`, it inserts `food_screenshots` with `meal_log_id` directly (no daily_logs lazy-create)
- [ ] `LogForm`'s existing daily screenshot upload still works exactly as before (regression)

**Verify:** `npm run build` → compiles; manual smoke test on `/log/[date]` — upload a nutrition screenshot and confirm the existing extraction → confirm → fill-form flow is unchanged

**Steps:** Rewrite screenshot-uploader.tsx with the UploadTarget discriminated union (branch on target.type to either lazily upsert daily_logs and insert with daily_log_id, or insert directly with meal_log_id) → update LogForm's <ScreenshotUploader> call site to pass target={{ type: 'daily', dailyLogId: existing?.id ?? null, date }} → npm run build → manual smoke test of existing daily upload flow → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/log/screenshot-uploader.tsx", "components/log/log-form.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["UploadTarget discriminated union exported and accepted as target prop", "daily target behavior unchanged (lazy daily_logs upsert + daily_log_id FK)", "meal target inserts food_screenshots with meal_log_id directly", "existing daily screenshot upload flow on /log/[date] regresses cleanly"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: MealEntrySheet Component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the bottom-sheet component that handles both adding and editing a meal entry — meal-type selection, screenshot-upload-and-AI-extract or manual macro entry, an optional note, and save/delete — following the existing `day-calendar-sheet.tsx` overlay/slide-up pattern.

**Files:**
- Create: `components/log/meal-entry-sheet.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] When `meal` is `null`, the sheet opens on a meal-type picker (breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack); selecting a type advances to the entry form
- [ ] When `meal` is provided, the sheet opens directly on the entry form pre-filled with the existing meal's type, macros, and note, and shows a Delete button
- [ ] The entry form shows an "Extract from screenshot" trigger that creates a draft `meal_logs` row on first tap, then renders `ScreenshotUploader` with `target: { type: 'meal', mealLogId }`; a successful extraction shows `MacroConfirm` and populates the macro fields on confirm
- [ ] Manual macro fields (calories/protein/fat/carbs) and a note field are always editable directly in the form
- [ ] Save calls `useUpsertMealLog()` with the chosen type, macros, and note (creating or updating as appropriate) and closes the sheet; Delete calls `useDeleteMealLog()` and closes the sheet
- [ ] Escape key and backdrop click dismiss the sheet via `onClose`

**Verify:** Manual smoke test — `npm run dev`, open `/log/[date]`, add a meal manually, add a meal via screenshot, edit an existing meal, delete an existing meal; confirm each flow saves/updates/removes the row and the sheet closes

**Steps:** Create meal-entry-sheet.tsx with a Stage state machine ('type' | 'form' | 'extracting' | 'confirm'); type stage shows the meal-type picker (skipped when editing); form stage shows a lazy-draft "Extract from screenshot" trigger that calls ensureDraft to create the meal_logs row then mounts ScreenshotUploader, plus always-visible manual macro inputs + note + Save/Cancel/Delete; extracting stage shows a loading state; confirm stage renders MacroConfirm and returns to form with populated fields; Escape/backdrop call onClose → npm run build → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/log/meal-entry-sheet.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["new entries start on meal-type picker, edits start on pre-filled form with delete", "screenshot entry lazily creates draft meal_logs row then uses ScreenshotUploader with meal target and MacroConfirm", "manual macro and note fields always editable", "Save/Delete call useUpsertMealLog/useDeleteMealLog and close the sheet", "Escape and backdrop click dismiss via onClose"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Mode-Aware Nutrition Section in LogForm + MealList + Water Input
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire everything together on `/log/[date]`: the nutrition section automatically switches between "single daily total" mode and "per-meal" mode based on whether any meals are logged for the date, add the `MealList` summary/list component, mount `MealEntrySheet`, and add the daily water field.

**Files:**
- Create: `components/log/meal-list.tsx`
- Modify: `components/log/log-form.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] On a date with no meal entries, `/log/[date]` shows the existing daily ScreenshotUploader and 4 editable macro inputs exactly as before, plus a new "+ Log by meal instead" link that opens MealEntrySheet
- [ ] On a date with one or more meal entries, the daily uploader and 4 macro inputs are replaced by a read-only "Today's totals" summary (via useNutritionForDate/sumMealMacros) and a meal list grouped by type with subtotals
- [ ] Tapping an existing meal entry reopens MealEntrySheet pre-filled for editing (with delete); tapping "+ Add meal" opens it for a new entry
- [ ] A "Water" number input (liters, one decimal) appears in the "Sleep & mood (optional)" section and round-trips through useUpsertLog via daily_logs.water_l
- [ ] Logging a day with no meals continues to behave exactly as today (regression)

**Verify:** Manual smoke test — `npm run dev`, visit `/log/[date]`: (1) fresh date shows daily uploader+4 fields and saves as before; (2) "+ Log by meal instead" → manual entry switches section into per-meal mode with totals; (3) screenshot-based meal entry extracts and updates totals; (4) editing an entry updates list/totals; (5) deleting an entry removes it and recomputes totals (reverting to daily mode if last meal); (6) water value saves and persists across reload

**Steps:** Create meal-list.tsx (read-only totals grid via sumMealMacros, groups by meal_type with per-group subtotals, tappable entries open MealEntrySheet for editing, "+ Add meal" opens it for new entries) → in LogForm add useMealLogsForDate(date) + showMealEntry state, add water_l to fields/useEffect-population/handleSubmit payload, replace the ScreenshotUploader+Nutrition block with a meals.length === 0 ternary (daily mode renders existing uploader+4-input grid plus "+ Log by meal instead"; meals mode renders <MealList date={date} />), mount <MealEntrySheet> when showMealEntry is true, add a Water numInput beside Sleep in the optional section → npm run build → manual smoke test of all 6 checks → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["components/log/meal-list.tsx", "components/log/log-form.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no-meals mode unchanged plus '+ Log by meal instead' link", "meals-present mode shows read-only totals summary and grouped meal list with subtotals", "tapping an entry opens edit sheet with delete; '+ Add meal' opens new-entry sheet", "water input persists through daily_logs.water_l via useUpsertLog", "no-meals regression path behaves exactly as before"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Wire useNutritionForDate into DashboardMetrics
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the Dashboard's "Calories" card reflect meal-summed totals on dates that have per-meal logs, and the existing `daily_logs.calories` value on dates that don't — via the shared `useNutritionForDate` hook, so the dashboard and `/log/[date]` always agree on "today's calories."

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/(app)/dashboard/dashboard-metrics.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] On a date with per-meal logs, the Calories card shows the sum across that date's meals
- [ ] On a date without per-meal logs, the Calories card shows `daily_logs.calories` exactly as before
- [ ] The Steps card is unaffected

**Verify:** Manual smoke test — `npm run dev`: (1) day with no meals → Calories card matches daily_logs.calories as before; (2) log meals for today, return to dashboard → Calories card shows the meal sum

**Steps:** Add `useNutritionForDate(today)` alongside the existing `useDailyLog(today)`, change the Calories MetricCard's `value` prop from `log?.calories` to `nutrition?.calories`, leave the Steps card sourced from `log?.steps` unchanged → npm run build → manual smoke test of both checks → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/(app)/dashboard/dashboard-metrics.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Calories card sources from useNutritionForDate (meal-summed when meals exist)", "Calories card falls back to daily_logs.calories on days without meals", "Steps card unaffected"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Weekly Check-In — Meal Distribution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make the AI weekly check-in prompt aware of how macros are distributed across meal types, additively — periods with no per-meal logs produce an unchanged prompt, periods with per-meal logs gain a "Meal distribution" section and an extra coaching-instruction clause.

**Files:**
- Modify: `lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.ts`
- Modify: `lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.test.ts`
- Modify: `app/api/ai/weekly-checkin/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `buildCheckinPrompt(targets, logs, mealLogs?)` accepts an optional third parameter (default `[]`) and remains a pure function
- [ ] When `mealLogs` is non-empty, the prompt includes a "Meal distribution" section listing average calories (rounded), percentage share (rounded), and average protein (rounded) per meal type, computed across distinct dates with per-meal logs
- [ ] When `mealLogs` is empty/omitted, the prompt contains no "Meal distribution" text and no extra coverage clause — unchanged from today's output shape
- [ ] `app/api/ai/weekly-checkin/route.ts` fetches `meal_logs` rows for the same period and passes them to `buildCheckinPrompt`

**Verify:** `npx vitest run lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.test.ts` → all tests pass (existing + new)

**Steps:** TDD — append 5 new test cases to weekly-checkin.test.ts (section present/absent, average+percentage+protein computation with worked example, coaching-instruction clause present/absent) → run, verify new tests fail → add MealLogRow type + buildMealDistributionSection helper + extend buildCheckinPrompt with optional mealLogs param, conditional distribution block, and conditional coverage clause → run, verify pass → update route.ts Promise.all to also fetch meal_logs for the period and pass through to buildCheckinPrompt → npm run build → manual smoke test on /check-in → commit.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.ts", "lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.test.ts", "app/api/ai/weekly-checkin/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run lib/anthropic/weekly-checkin.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildCheckinPrompt accepts optional mealLogs param defaulting to [] and stays pure", "prompt gains Meal distribution section with avg calories/percentage/protein per meal type when mealLogs present", "prompt unchanged in shape when mealLogs absent", "route fetches meal_logs for the check-in period and passes them through"]}
```
